title: AdaDo Agent Definition
description: Canonical schema for an AdaDo agent definition. Lives as the `agent:` block inside an app manifest (apps/<slug>.yaml). See docs/AGENT-SPEC.md.

id.description: Unique, stable agent identifier. Must match the app's chat_endpoint agent= param.

display_name.description: Human-facing name shown in the AdaDo UI.

description.description: One-line summary of what the agent does, in plain user language.

model.description: Model id the agent runs on (e.g. claude-cli/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). Cheapest tier that does the job.

capabilities.description: User-facing list of concrete things the agent can do. Each item is a short imperative or example phrase.

required_apps.description: App ids this agent depends on being installed/running (usually its own app plus any it integrates with).

mcp_tools.description: MCP tool name patterns the agent is allowed to call. Globs permitted (e.g. mcp__plane__*).

trigger_hooks.description: Events that activate the agent. `message` = user chat; `cron` = scheduled; `webhook` = inbound HTTP; `event` = internal bus; `manual` = user-invoked only.

config.description: Trigger-specific config: cron expression, webhook path, event name, or message pattern.

auth.description: What credentials the agent needs to reach its app/API.

location.description: Where the credential is presented, e.g. 'header:X-API-Key', 'env:PLANE_API_TOKEN'.

api_base.description: Base URL of the app API the agent talks to.
